description: Defines classes and structures for handling UCI indication processing, including UCI actions, timeout notifications, and the UCI indication selector logic within a scheduler context.

classes.name: uci_indication_timeout_notifier
classes.description: Abstract class for notifying when a UCI grant times out without receiving feedback.

classes.name: uci_indication_selector
classes.description: Handles processing of UCI indication PDUs, managing UCI grants, timeouts, and feedback within the scheduler.

methods.name: handle_uci_ind_pdu
methods.description: Processes a UCI indication PDU received at a specific slot.

methods.name: handle_result
methods.description: Handles scheduler results at each slot.

methods.name: handle_discarded_ucis
methods.description: Resets UCI grants when an error indication is received.
